title: Evaluating the Causal Faithfulness of SHAP as a Candidate Attribution Method for SAE Features
abstract: arXiv:2610.17898v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sparse autoencoders decompose language model representations into interpretable features, but feature interpretation in this literature remains predominantly correlational. Attribution methods offer more direct estimates of feature influence, yet their faithfulness to actual causal effects has not been systematically evaluated in the SAE setting. We apply SHAP-based attribution to SAE latent features and evaluate it against direct causal intervention, using sentiment classification on SST-2 with GPT-2 Small and a 32,768-feature layer-7 SAE as a testbed. We compare SHAP to Integrated Gradients, Gradient$\times$Input, and probe-weight baselines across linear and MLP probe arms, scoring each against feature ablation and activation steering measured through the language model's own logit difference. Most faithfulness associations we measure do not survive multiple-comparison correction, and attribution methods that agree strongly with one

translated_title: 评估SHAP作为SAE特征候选归因方法的因果忠实性
translated_abstract: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）将语言模型的表示分解为可解释的特征，但该领域文献中的特征解释目前仍以相关性分析为主。归因方法能够更直接地估计特征的影响，但其对实际因果效应的忠实性尚未在SAE场景中得到系统性评估。我们将基于SHAP的归因方法应用于SAE潜在特征，并将其与直接因果干预进行对比评估，以GPT-2 Small和一个具有32,768个特征的第7层SAE在SST-2情感分类任务上作为测试平台。在线性探针和MLP探针两种设置下，我们将SHAP与积分梯度、梯度×输入以及探针权重等基线方法进行比较，并以特征消融和激活引导为评分依据，通过语言模型自身的logit差异来衡量。我们测量到的大多数忠实性关联在经过多重比较校正后不再显著，而彼此高度一致的归因方法……
tldr: 该论文首次在SAE场景下系统评估了SHAP等归因方法对特征真实因果效应的忠实性，发现在多重比较校正后大多数忠实性关联不显著，表明现有归因方法尚不能可靠替代直接因果干预。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates the causal faithfulness of SHAP and other attribution methods for SAE features against direct causal interventions, finding that most faithfulness associations do not survive multiple-comparison correction, suggesting current attribution methods cannot yet reliably substitute for direct intervention.
